common.cancel.description: Button that cancels the current operation.

common.retry.description: Button that retries a failed operation.

tripList.title.description: Heading of the trip list screen.

tripList.empty.description: Shown in the trip list when no trip has been created.

tripList.stopCount.description: Number of stops in a trip, shown under the trip title.

offline.status.ready.description: Offline package state: all required resources are downloaded and verified.

export.preflight.missingTiles.message: {count, plural, one {# map tile is missing} other {# map tiles are missing}}. Download the offline package before exporting.
export.preflight.missingTiles.description: Export preflight error when map tiles required by the timeline are not stored on the device.

theme.classic.description.message: Light map and dark route; for general use
theme.classic.description.description: Description of the classic theme, shown under its name.

theme.night.description.message: Dark map and glowing route; for evening viewing and projection

theme.portrait.name.description: Name of the theme designed for 9:16.

theme.portrait.description.message: Large title at the top and media below; for 9:16

maps.title.description: Heading of the maps dialog, where map regions are downloaded.

maps.intro.message: Download the map of each region you travel to. Maps are stored on this device and work without a connection.
maps.intro.description: Introduction at the top of the maps dialog.

maps.privacy.message: The download source can see which regions you download, and nothing else.
maps.privacy.description: Privacy note in the maps dialog. The source is Overture Maps' public storage.

maps.attribution.message: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation
maps.attribution.description: Attribution required by the map data licenses. Keep the names unchanged.

maps.status.notDownloaded.description: State of a region whose map is not on the device.

maps.status.checking.description: Shown while the size of a region is determined before downloading.

maps.status.downloading.description: Download progress; completed and total are formatted sizes such as 120 MB.

maps.status.paused.description: State of a paused download; sizes are formatted.

maps.status.verifying.description: State while a downloaded map is verified and its place names are indexed.

maps.status.ready.description: State of a downloaded region, with the storage it uses.

maps.status.insufficientStorage.description: State when the region does not fit into the free storage; sizes are formatted.

maps.status.failed.message: {reason, select, network {Could not reach the download source.} unavailable {This map version is no longer offered. Download the current one.} changed {The map changed during the download. Download it again.} damaged {The downloaded data is damaged.} missing {Files of this map are missing, possibly removed by the browser.} other {The download failed.}}
maps.status.failed.description: Why a download failed or a map cannot be used.

maps.status.updateAvailable.description: Shown on a ready region when a newer map version exists; release is a version such as 2026-11-18.0.

maps.confirm.description: Asked before a download starts, with the region size and the free storage.

maps.confirmUnknownFree.description: Asked before a download starts when the browser does not report the free storage.

maps.action.resume.description: Button that continues a paused or failed download.

maps.action.update.description: Button that downloads the newer version of a region.

maps.action.delete.description: Button that deletes a downloaded region from the device.

maps.action.checkUpdates.description: Button that checks whether newer map versions exist.

maps.status.copying.description: Progress while map files opened from the device are copied into the application's storage; sizes are formatted.

maps.files.title.description: Heading of the list of maps opened from files on the device instead of downloaded.

maps.files.hint.message: Open the PMTiles files of the Overture Maps themes base, transportation and divisions together, and places for points of interest, for example extracts made with pmtiles extract. The files are copied into this application.
maps.files.hint.description: Explains which files can be opened. Keep the theme names and 'pmtiles extract' unchanged.

maps.files.open.description: Button that opens map files already on the device.

maps.files.failed.message: {reason, select, damaged {A file is damaged or is not a PMTiles map file.} unsupported {A file is not an Overture Maps theme, or two files hold the same theme.} incomplete {The base, transportation and divisions files are needed together.} other {The map files could not be opened.}}
maps.files.failed.description: Why map files opened from the device cannot be used.

region.japanChugoku.description: Map region name. Chūgoku is a region of western Japan, not China.

app.loading.description: Shown while the application opens its storage at start-up.

app.unsupported.message: This browser cannot run TripReplay. It needs WebGL 2, the origin private file system and IndexedDB. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
app.unsupported.description: Shown instead of the application when a required browser feature is missing.

app.startFailed.message: TripReplay could not open its storage: {message}
app.startFailed.description: Shown when opening storage fails at start-up; message is the technical error.

preview.empty.message: Download a map to see it here.
preview.empty.description: Shown in the map preview while no region is downloaded.

search.label.message: Search places in the downloaded maps
search.label.description: Accessible label and placeholder of the place search box.

search.noResults.description: Shown when a place search has no result.

search.coordinates.description: Search result for pasted coordinates or a map link; lat and lon are numbers.

search.shortLink.message: Short links cannot be read without a connection to their service. Open the link and copy the full address instead.
search.shortLink.description: Shown when a short map link such as maps.app.goo.gl is pasted into the search box.

common.delete.description: Button that deletes an item after confirmation.

common.back.description: Button that returns to the previous screen.

tripList.createFirst.description: Call to action in the trip list when no trip exists.

tripList.newTitle.description: Title of a newly created trip, which the user renames.

tripList.dates.description: Date range of a trip on its card; first and last are formatted dates.

tripList.noDates.description: Shown on a trip card instead of dates while the trip has no stops.

tripList.media.description: Storage used by a trip's media on its card; size is formatted, for example 1.2 GB.

tripList.open.description: Button that opens a trip for editing.

tripList.titleLabel.description: Label of the trip name field.

tripList.confirmDelete.message: Delete “{title}”? Its stops and media assignments cannot be restored without a backup.
tripList.confirmDelete.description: Confirmation before a trip is deleted.

header.maps.description: Header button that opens the maps dialog.

header.trips.description: Header button that returns to the trip list.

itinerary.empty.message: Add the first stop by searching for a place, or paste coordinates or a map link.
itinerary.empty.description: Shown in the itinerary while the trip has no stops.

itinerary.day.description: Heading of a day in the itinerary; date is a formatted date.

itinerary.dateLabel.description: Label of the date used for stops added next.

itinerary.moveUp.description: Button that moves a stop one place earlier.

itinerary.moveDown.description: Button that moves a stop one place later.

itinerary.rename.description: Button and field label for renaming a stop.

itinerary.unnamed.description: Name of a stop added from bare coordinates; the user can rename it.

save.saved.description: Autosave state: all changes are stored.

save.pending.description: Autosave state: changes wait for the save delay.

save.saving.description: Autosave state: a save is in progress.

save.error.description: Autosave state after a failed save; the next change tries again.

save.conflict.message: This trip was changed in another tab. Reload it to continue.
save.conflict.description: Autosave state when another tab saved a newer version.

player.play.description: Button that starts playback of the recap preview.

player.pause.description: Button that pauses playback of the recap preview.

player.time.description: Playback position and length of the recap, as minutes:seconds.

player.position.description: Accessible name of the slider that moves through the recap.

player.aspectRatio.description: Accessible name of the 16:9 and 9:16 buttons.

player.fullscreen.description: Button that plays the recap in full screen; Escape exits.

player.noMap.message: No downloaded map contains these stops; the recap is shown without a base map.
player.noMap.description: Shown under the preview when no ready map region contains the trip's stops.

player.segment.opening.description: Segment of the recap timeline: overview with the trip title.

player.segment.travel.description: Segment of the recap timeline: the camera moves to the next stop.

player.segment.title.description: Segment of the recap timeline: the stop name is shown.

player.segment.photo.description: Segment of the recap timeline: a photo is shown.

player.segment.video.description: Segment of the recap timeline: a video is played.

player.segment.closing.description: Segment of the recap timeline: overview with the trip summary.

recap.summary.message: {stops, plural, one {# stop} other {# stops}} · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
recap.summary.description: Trip summary shown at the end of the recap.
